scope: Minnesota Project Korean scope-change and implementation actors

actors.name: 원용석

roles.role: 기획처장 / Director, ROK Office of Planning
roles.evidence: National Assembly plenary record 1953-09-29 names 원용석 as 기획처장; AKS biography says he served as 기획처장 from 1953
AKS biography bibliography notes contemporary appointment report

actions: University of Minnesota first semiannual report identifies the Director of the ROK Office of Planning as one of three Korean-side principals proposing a major reallocation of the Minnesota contract
actors.attribution_limits: The semiannual report names the office, not Won. The identity bridge rests on independent official Korean records placing Won in the office at the relevant time. Do not infer that he drafted the proposal personally until Korean planning-office papers are recovered.
open_leads: recover Office of Planning memorandum proposing the $750,000 exchange ceiling and physical-plant/equipment reallocation

actors.name: 이선근
actors.romanized: Lee Seon-geun / Lee Sun-keun / Yi Son-gun

roles.evidence: UN Commission report A/2947 executive roster; corroborating historical literature

actions: identified by office and tenure as one of the Korean principals proposing a major contract change after project launch
on Nov.9 the Minister of Education informed the Minnesota side that the overall plan had Republic of Korea approval while recommending a revised American-Korean faculty exchange ratio
actors.attribution_limits: Do not treat ministerial communication as proof that Lee alone originated the scope change or that he possessed sole legal approval authority.
open_leads: recover Ministry of Education internal approval routing
identify officials who drafted the faculty-ratio recommendation

actors.name: 최규남
actions: first semiannual report identifies the SNU president, then in the United States under American-Korean Foundation sponsorship, as one of the Korean principals proposing the major contract reallocation
actors.attribution_limits: Recover correspondence before assigning exact wording or authorship of the proposal.
open_leads: recover Choi's U.S. itinerary and Minnesota correspondence
recover proposal drafts sent from or to Choi
compare his position with Lee Seon-geun and Won Yong-seok

actors.name: 박씨 문교부 인사 (Dr. Park)

roles.role: Ministry of Education official photographed at University of Minnesota

actions: appears with SNU president Choi Kyu-nam, agriculture-college representative Lee, Seoul High School principal Kim, and Minnesota agriculture dean Harold Macy
actors.attribution_limits: Do not merge with Park Cheol-jae. Current archival metadata supplies only surname/title and ministry affiliation.
open_leads: recover UMedia item reverse-caption or accession notes
compare December 1954 Korean education delegation lists
test Park Cheol-jae only after itinerary evidence

actors.name: 박철재
actors.attribution_limits: Potential identity candidate for archival Dr. Park remains explicitly unmerged.

actors.name: 오순섭

roles.role: Dean, College of Veterinary Medicine, Seoul National University

actions: argued for veterinary inclusion and persuaded Choi Kyu-nam
